terme.definition: Plaque de plâtre à carton vert, traitée contre l'humidité, posée dans les salles d'eau.

candidats.description: A "green board" can refer to a traditional green chalkboard used in schools for writing with chalk, offering a softer look than blackboards, or it can mean a type of moisture-resistant drywall (greenboard) used in construction
